review_description: Great value for money. The quality of the system was superb. and the installation was a breeze. Only problem I had was the delay due to the China/Australia trade ware and the administrative side between the company and my energy provider.

From quote to installation took under 2 weeks. Customer-friendly team, they respond to all enquiries. I was very impressed by their after-sale support, with some issues noticed and addressed with them and they sent their installer the next day to rectify the issue. Highly recommended.
